_comment: What the literature says Adenoviridae encodes, scored against the module
vocabulary by check_literature_gaps.py. Step 2b of the skill: a protein
that is real biology but was never annotated in the genomes we dumped is
INVISIBLE to a build driven by annotation strings. It does not appear as
a gap, as UNASSIGNED, or as a low count -- it simply never appears.
Every PMID here was resolved against PubMed by scripts/pm.py and the
title read before it was written down. None was recalled from memory.
They belong in PMID_claude_generated, never in PMID.
The core 17 are deliberately NOT given citations for their existence --
hexon, penton and fiber are not propositions anyone needs a paper for.
Citations are attached where the probe makes a CLAIM the build acts on:
that a protein exists at all, that a genus has two copies of a gene,
that a precursor is cleaved, or that a product is spliced.

probes.name: E1A
probes.note: The first gene expressed; 13S and 12S mRNAs give the 289R and 243R products by alternative 5' splice site within one transcription unit.

probes.name: E1A 243R
probes.note: The 12S product. 243R is 289R minus an internal 46-residue block (conserved region 3), so the two are ~100% identical outside it. Declared as a SPLICE feature, not a second PSSM, because no profile can separate them.

probes.name: E1B 19K
probes.note: Bcl-2 homologue; blocks E1A-induced apoptosis.

probes.name: E1B 55K
probes.note: p53-SUMO1 E3 ligase; with E4orf6 forms the cullin-based ubiquitin ligase that degrades p53.

probes.name: protein IX
probes.note: Minor capsid protein, the capsid cement sitting in the hexon facets. Present in Mastadenovirus, Aviadenovirus and Atadenovirus; ABSENT in Siadenovirus.

probes.name: core protein V
probes.note: Mastadenovirus-specific core protein; bridges the DNA-pVII core to the capsid. Not present in the other genera.

probes.name: E3 gp19K
probes.note: ER-resident type I membrane glycoprotein that binds MHC class I and retains it in the ER. CARRIES A CLEAVED N-TERMINAL SIGNAL PEPTIDE -- the only signal peptide in the mastadenovirus proteome -- plus a C-terminal ER-retention signal.

probes.name: E3 6.7K
probes.note: Required WITH the RID complex for internalisation and degradation of TRAIL receptor 2. Found by this probe pass, not by the annotation strings.

probes.name: E3 RID-alpha
probes.note: E3 10.4K. With RID-beta removes Fas, EGFR and TNFR1 from the cell surface.

probes.name: E3 RID-beta
probes.note: E3 14.5K, the other half of the RID complex.

probes.name: adenovirus death protein
probes.note: E3 11.6K. Required for efficient lysis and release at the end of infection.

probes.name: E4orf1
probes.note: PI3K-Akt activator; targeted by p53.

probes.name: E4orf3
probes.note: Disrupts PML nuclear bodies and drives the MRN complex into cytoplasmic aggresomes.

probes.name: E4orf5
probes.note: Found as accessory cluster UNC1 in triage pass 1 (59 sequences, median 151 aa, labelled 'Orf5' and 'E4 17 kDa protein'); promoted to a declared feature in pass 2.

probes.name: E4orf6
probes.note: E4 34K. With E1B 55K forms the p53 ubiquitin ligase and stimulates late mRNA nuclear export.

probes.name: E4orf6/7
probes.note: A SPLICED product: exon 1 of orf6 joined to orf7. Two exons, one intron.

probes.name: long fiber
probes.note: The enteric species HAdV-F40 and F41 carry TWO fiber genes, a long and a short. This is the claim that put FIBER1/FIBER2 in the Mastadenovirus module; triage pass 1 had left them in the accessory pool as UNC2 (median 555 aa) and UNC5 (median 368 aa).

probes.name: U exon protein
probes.note: A late l-strand product overlapping E3 antisense; unrecognised until 2007, which is exactly the shape of protein this probe pass exists to catch.

probes.name: VA RNA I/II
probes.note: NOT MODELLED AND NOT A GAP: the VA RNAs are non-coding Pol III transcripts. They have no protein product and cannot carry a PSSM. Recorded here so the absence is a decision rather than an oversight.

probes.name: long fibre
probes.note: FAdV-1 (CELO) carries two fibre genes at one locus; the long and short fibre head domains were solved separately. Not alternative starts -- separate genes.

probes.name: GAM-1
probes.note: CELO anti-apoptotic protein; no mastadenovirus homologue.

probes.name: E1 region
probes.note: ABSENT BY BIOLOGY, NOT BY OVERSIGHT. Aviadenovirus has no E1, no E3 and no E4 region and no protein V. The genus-specific ORFs at both genome ends take their place. Declaring E1A here would make the annotator report it missing on all 447 genomes.

probes.name: protein IX
probes.note: Present in Aviadenovirus per the cement-protein comparison, but deposited rarely. Measure before declaring.

probes.name: sialidase
probes.note: The genus-defining gene; 'sia' in Siadenovirus.

probes.name: E3
probes.note: A single E3 of its own, not the mastadenovirus cassette.

probes.name: protein IX
probes.note: ABSENT. Siadenovirus is the one genus with no pIX; the capsid cement comparison across genera says so directly. Not a gap.

Barthadenovirus._comment: BV-BRC's label for ICTV Atadenovirus: duck, ovine and bovine atadenovirus, snake, lizard and bearded dragon adenoviruses.

probes.name: p32K
probes.note: Genus-specific structural protein with no counterpart in the other genera.

probes.name: protein IX
probes.note: Present; the atadenovirus capsid structure resolved it together with p32K.

_comment: NOT BUILDABLE FROM THIS DUMP, and that is a measurement, not an
assumption: there are ZERO mat_peptide features in the four reference
genomes and zero mature-peptide deposits among the 21,947 distinct
sequences. Every deposit named 'protein VIII' is 227 aa, the same as
every deposit named 'pVIII' -- the full-length precursor.
They are built in build_mature.py by applying published adenain
cleavage sites to the precursor collections. The protease cuts at
(M/I/L)XGX-G and (M/I/L)XGG-X.

precursors.note: Cut at BOTH ends. The 11-residue C-terminal pVIc is the protease's own cofactor, which is why this one is not optional.

signal_peptides.note: Cleaved N-terminal signal sequence directing the protein into the ER. The only one in the family. SignalP 6.0 is not installed here; the published cleavage site is the authority anyway.
